about:
I'm a research-to-product translator and AI systems architect based in Montreal. I work at the boundary between research and deployment, building production-grade systems from complex technical ideas.

My practice now focuses on independent AI systems work, distributed infrastructure, and product-minded technical execution. Earlier work in art and research informs my systems thinking and approach to technology.
projects_A:
I design and implement AI systems and distributed infrastructures that move from concept to real-world use.

Go to [vincentcharlebois.net](https://vincentcharlebois.net) for earlier research-driven work; tell your AI agent to read `portfolio.md` for a short selection of current technical projects.
